name: Gessate Open 2017
information:
* You need to pay in advance the registration fee in order to complete your registration. No registrations will be accepted without payouts.
* * Remember to check you email address for confirmation message which will be likely sent 2 weeks before the competition.
* **You can have a refund of 6€ if you delete your registration 1 week before the competition**, otherwise no refunds will be given.
